why: Re-roll the off-model Shelly anchor and bunker and the Chonks latch against the model sheet; badges for the local sponsors of the one-System-AI canon (Bellevue Consortium of Doors '94, Hydros-9 on its ninth pivot, the Benthic Collective, Cadabra); Barnaby as the wild legend of the Narrows; the remaining Off-Beat opponents, Kiro and Lady Luck; the companion welcome plates and a Safe Room dawn plate.

renders.name: card-cast-shelly-anchor
renders.subject: Shelly the geoduck performing his Anchor ability: {GEODUCK}, the shell dug deep into cracked dark dungeon stone so only its rim shows, the long siphon neck rising out of the rock and braced like a mooring line, a steel carabiner clipped to a stout ring on the shell with a taut climbing rope leading out of frame, eelgrass and wet grit around the stone, stubborn and utterly immovable.

place.where: Shelly section, beside the Anchor ability
place.alt: Shelly the geoduck dug into cracked stone, his long siphon braced like a mooring line, a carabiner and rope clipped to his shell

renders.name: card-cast-shelly-bunker
renders.subject: Shelly the geoduck performing his Shell Bunker ability: {GEODUCK}, the siphon neck pulled halfway into the shell and the shell hardened with a faint sea-glass green shield shimmer, lying on wet sand like a small tower shield, a steel carabiner on a ring at the shell's edge, rain drops bouncing off the shimmer.

place.where: Shelly section, beside the Shell Bunker ability
place.alt: Shelly the geoduck pulled into his shell behind a sea-glass green shield shimmer, rain bouncing off it

renders.name: card-cast-chonks-latch
renders.subject: Chonks performing his Suction Latch ability: {LUMPSUCKER}, suction-sealed tight onto one lens of a pair of tilted reading glasses held by a startled accountant's hand at the edge of frame, spines flared, comically proud, spreadsheet paper fluttering in the dark background.

place.where: Chonks section, beside the Suction Latch ability
place.alt: Chonks the round green lumpsucker stuck to one lens of an accountant's reading glasses, spines flared

renders.name: card-cast-barnaby-legend
renders.subject: {BARNABY}, swimming free and huge through the sunken steel girders of a collapsed suspension bridge deck overgrown with white plumose anemones and kelp, deep green Tacoma Narrows current, small rockfish scattering, one great eye on the viewer, majestic and calm, the legend of the Narrows.

place.where: Barnaby section, first image under the heading, before the stats table
place.alt: Barnaby, a huge wild Giant Pacific Octopus with a brass collar, swimming free through the sunken girders of the Galloping Gertie wreck

renders.name: header-gertie-wreck-den
renders.subject: the sunken wreck of a collapsed 1940 suspension bridge on the floor of the Tacoma Narrows, twisted steel deck plates and girders turned into a vast artificial reef, white plumose anemones, kelp, lingcod and rockfish, a dark den mouth under a fallen girder with the tip of one enormous red octopus arm curling out, cold green light from far above, quiet and ancient.

place.where: after the closing log where Barnaby goes home to the Sound
place.alt: The Galloping Gertie wreck on the floor of the Tacoma Narrows, an anemone-covered reef of girders with one red octopus arm curling out of a den

renders.name: card-opponent-tourist-pod-offbeat
renders.subject: the Rain-Shell Tourist Pod Off-Beat: three cheerful tourists of different ages in matching bright rain shells and lanyards on slick wet tide-pool rocks, selfie stick tangled, one slipping into a split, umbrellas flipped inside out by wind, laughing, rhythm-broken but game.

place.where: where the tourist pod leaves the tide pools (the Floor 1 opponent result)
place.alt: Three tourists in matching rain shells slipping on wet tide-pool rocks, umbrellas flipped, laughing

renders.name: card-opponent-devrel-swarm-offbeat
renders.subject: the Developer Advocate Swarm Off-Beat: five enthusiastic developer advocates of different ages and backgrounds in matching hoodies and conference lanyards, mid-demo, a blank glowing laptop screen frozen, one dropping a handful of blank stickers, two colliding while pointing at the same blank slide, laughing, rhythm-broken but game.

place.where: beside the passage where the party wins the boss battle
place.alt: Five developer advocates in matching hoodies colliding mid-demo, stickers flying, a frozen blank laptop screen

renders.name: card-opponent-ferry-commuters-offbeat
renders.subject: the Ferry-Line Commuter Horde Off-Beat: a crowd of rain-soaked commuters in raincoats with coffee cups and backpacks on a muddy cliff path at dawn, everyone stopped at once because they missed the beat, coffee sloshing, one hat blowing away, sheepish grins.

place.where: after the dance-off result against the Ferry-Line Commuter Horde
place.alt: A crowd of rain-soaked commuters frozen mid-step on a muddy cliff path at dawn, coffee sloshing

renders.name: card-opponent-kiro-scripter
renders.subject: Kiro the Doomsday Scripter, Floor 2 opponent: a cheerful, sleep-deprived scripter in a hoodie with headphones around the neck, sitting cross-legged on top of a vending machine in a flooded eelgrass meadow, laptop open with a blank glowing terminal window, one finger hovering eagerly over the enter key, an energy drink can, mischievous grin, ready to run any command.

place.where: where Kiro offers to run any command (the HumanInTheLoop bonus)
place.alt: Kiro the Doomsday Scripter cross-legged on a vending machine in a flooded eelgrass meadow, one finger over the enter key

renders.name: card-opponent-lady-luck
renders.subject: Lady Luck, the System AI's croupier on Floor 3: a glamorous casino croupier in a sea-green sequined vest and a dealer visor, behind a gaming table of iridescent abalone shell inside a bull kelp forest, tossing a pair of glowing dice with pips, announcing like a boxing ring announcer, one hand raised.

place.where: where the page introduces Lady Luck and her table
place.alt: Lady Luck, a croupier in a sea-green sequined vest, tossing glowing dice over an abalone shell table in a kelp forest

renders.name: card-opponent-cadabra-drones
renders.subject: a swarm of {CADABRA_DRONE}s diving through a flooded dungeon hall to drop glowing loot boxes, one drone tangled in kelp, one with its parcel claw stuck on a pipe, rotor wash spraying rain, funny and harmless machines, no people.

place.where: section 5, beside the Loot boxes bullet (Cadabra drones deliver every box)
place.alt: A swarm of boxy brown delivery drones diving through a flooded hall to drop glowing loot boxes, one tangled in kelp

renders.name: icon-sponsor-bellevue
renders.subject: a round cold steel-grey enamel sponsor medallion for a tech monolith, raised relief of a half-open office door with violet light spilling out, small glass towers over a calm lake behind it, beige-desktop nostalgia, brass rim with rivets, corporate and smug, no window grid, no flag.

place.alt: Bellevue Consortium sponsor medallion: a half-open door glowing violet over glass towers

renders.name: icon-sponsor-hydros9
renders.subject: a round glossy teal enamel sponsor medallion for a venture-funded water-tech startup, a single water drop over nine small curved arrows stacked like a pivot chart, startup-sticker sheen, sea-glass green inlay, brass rim, eager and shiny.

place.alt: Hydros-9 sponsor medallion: a teal water drop over nine stacked pivot arrows

renders.name: icon-sponsor-benthic
renders.subject: a round weathered brass sponsor medallion for a Ballard fishing-and-kombucha cooperative, a glass fishing float and a small kombucha jar side by side on a coil of net, salt-crusted, warm and homespun.

place.alt: Benthic Collective sponsor medallion: a glass fishing float and a kombucha jar on a coil of net

renders.name: icon-sponsor-cadabra
renders.subject: a round brass-rimmed contractor medallion, a sealed cardboard parcel with a small rocket fin and a single drone rotor attached, kraft-brown and steel, efficient and slightly ominous, no arrow, no smile.

place.alt: Cadabra, Inc. contractor medallion: a cardboard parcel with a rocket fin and a drone rotor

renders.name: header-welcome-shelly
renders.subject: a wide bare sand flat at a minus low tide under the dungeon, the water pulled far back, eelgrass meadow at the edges, and in the middle of the scoured sand {GEODUCK}, lying on its side in the open with its long siphon draped across the sand, a puff of sea mist rising from the siphon tip, a single warm lantern beside it, quiet and tender.

place.where: right before Shelly's welcome log (Day 2, 1400 low water)
place.alt: A geoduck lying on bare scoured sand at low tide, its long siphon draped across the flat, sea mist rising beside a lantern

renders.name: header-welcome-chonks
renders.subject: inside a towering bull kelp forest, a hollow kelp bulb bursting overhead in a spray of bubbles, the kelp stipe whipping, and {LUMPSUCKER} flying through the water toward a black forearm guard on a gloved arm entering from the frame edge, no person visible beyond the forearm, comedic motion blur.

place.where: right before Chonks's welcome paragraph (after Step 4)
place.alt: A kelp bulb bursting overhead as a round green lumpsucker flies toward a gloved forearm guard

renders.name: header-safe-room-dawn
renders.subject: the same Safe Room interior at dawn: heavy glulam Douglas fir beams, red cedar walls, basalt hearth with embers, big windows onto calm grey water with first pale gold light, wool blankets folded, a kayak paddle in a rack, a wet drysuit hanging to dry, a clear backpack water tank on a bench, quiet morning after a night's sleep.

place.where: where the party wakes on Day 10 and the session comes back
place.alt: The Safe Room at dawn, embers in a basalt hearth, a drysuit drying and a clear water tank on a bench
